Summary: Hell is the sobering reality of eternal separation from God in judgment for those who reject Him, taught plainly by Jesus Himself. It underscores both God's holiness and the urgency of the gospel, which offers rescue to everyone who turns to Christ. Christians speak of hell not with satisfaction but with tears, pleading with others to be reconciled to God.
RelatedDoctrines: Hell; Final Judgment; Wrath of God
RelatedQuestions: How can a loving God send people to hell?; Is hell eternal or temporary?
